recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless a future FHIR-I decision changes logical-model rendering policy.
issue_request: FHIR-14386 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I STU3 change request asking for logical model pages to provide access to their XML and JSON StructureDefinition views, comparable to the structure definition tabs available for resources.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 612773218a0035c9f20dab91887d004b45f2b49d, which added XML and JSON master-definition links to source/template-logical.html. Later template reorganization moved that file to tools/templates/template-logical.html while preserving the behavior.
additional_context: The current source has active pattern pages for Definition, Event, and Request, and the current CI-rendered Definition logical pattern page includes links to definition.xml.html and definition.json.html. Community searches found no direct FHIR-14386 Zulip or Confluence references; a later IG Authoring minutes page discussed IG Publisher logical-model rendering choices but did not reverse the core-spec change.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative current template already provides the requested links, and the current rendered page confirms the behavior.
